The constructive listed version is the sibling node 166. claim_boundary.supports: For arbitrary types H, V, S (kernel-checked, lean4/HistoryReport.lean): factoring through the report image implies constancy on report fibers without any axiom; constancy on fibers implies factoring when a selector of a history in every nonempty fiber is supplied as a hypothesis, again without any axiom, and for an arbitrary report the selector is obtained from Classical.choice (the kernel reports Classical.choice for selector_exists and for the unconditional criterion, Quot.sound for uniqueness on the image via funext); the factor is unique on the image; two histories with one report and two answers refute factoring; off the image the extension to all reports is not unique under the hypotheses of off_image_not_unique: DecidableEq of the report type, an off-image point v0, an extension f, and a value s different from f v0 (so at least two answers); for a surjective report the extension is unique. Exhaustive native check over ALL report and question functions for 16 small (h,v,s) triples including empty and degenerate ones (including h=0, v=2, s=0 where the empty question factors through the empty image but has no extension): factoring equals fiber constancy pair by pair, factoring counts equal sum_k C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k (recomputed independently of the enumeration, with the fiber-constant count recomputed separately from set partitions), every factoring pair has exactly one factor on the image and s^(v-k) extensions. The finite native check is combinatorial corroboration only and is insensitive to the choice question, since choice is provable on finite types.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Necessity of a selector or of Classical.choice for the direction constancy => factoring (this node proves no independence or unprovability result; the selector is a hypothesis, not a construction); the constructive listed-history reconstruction (node PG-PREGEN-CONSTRUCTIVE-SUMMARY); any structure on H, V or S, probability, measurement or physical interpretation of reports.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: For arbitrary types, an answer factors through the report image iff it is constant on report fibers, uniquely on the image; the direction constancy => factoring is proved from a selector of fiber representatives (a hypothesis, axiom-free) and, for an arbitrary report, with Classical.choice; necessity of a selector or of choice is not shown; verified exhaustively on 16 small function-space triples.
claim_boundary.next_test: Decide whether constancy on fibers => factoring through the image is provable without Classical.choice for an arbitrary history type (prove it, or give a choice-free model in which a fiber-constant question fails to factor), beyond the selector hypothesis proved here and the listed-history version of node 166.

second_review.notes: Cold read of run 20261021T132245Z_staged. lean4/HistoryReport.lean is byte-identical (sha 420e89ea...) to the p1 copy; the p2 log reports literally: fiberConstant_of_factors, factors_of_fiberConstant_of_selector, not_factors_of_split, off_image_not_unique with no axioms; selector_exists and history_report_criterion Classical.choice only; factor_unique_on_image and extension_unique_of_surjective Quot.sound; instance_split propext. Earlier-pass amendments are all applied: narrowest_claim no longer says 'needs exactly a selector' and says 'necessity of a selector or of choice is not shown'; supports names the hidden off-image hypotheses; supports says the finite native check is combinatorial corroboration insensitive to choice; the edge case (0,2,0) was added as the 16th public case and its record (factoring 1, extensions_total 0) is correct. The rebuild strengthened the checker: fiber_constant is now computed separately from restricted-growth-string partitions (falling(v,k) * s^k per k-block partition) and factoring from the Stirling closed forms C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k; both agree on all 16 cases; no tolerance, ints type-checked, case set compared sorted; checker pin hashes match. 10 semantic mutants (every question factors, injective only, extension unique off image, surjective with freedom, image vs codomain, criterion fails on a pair, two factors, empty histories refused, coarser kernel, empty answers extend uniquely) are all rejected with the expected leaf; the two near misses requested by the earlier pass (coarser kernel, empty answer set) are present. Remaining weaknesses, none rebuild-forcing: (1) the checker's equality fiber_constant == factoring is an identity between two closed-form sums, so the pair-by-pair equivalence stated in supports rests on the producer's brute-force enumeration plus the kernel theorem fiberConstant_of_factors; the checker certifies only that the producer counts equal the closed forms. (2) max_factor_multiplicity is hard-coded in the checker as 1 if factoring else 0 (docstring cites factor_unique_on_image); it is a theorem-derived constant, not recomputed, and cannot make a wrong certificate pass because it is the theorem value. (3) The whole native part is blind to the choice question (as supports says), so none of the 16 records or 10 mutants touches the unpaid bridge; next_test is the node's own and differs from does_not_support. (4) review.reviewed_target_qualification correctly records that the DAG clause 'a constructive listed-history version is not established' is stale. No false statement inside the claim boundary, no wrong certificate can pass, Lean anchors say what the claim says.

earlier_pass.notes: lean4/HistoryReport.lean (sha identical to p1 copy) recompiles exit 0; axiom reports confirmed literally: fiberConstant_of_factors, factors_of_fiberConstant_of_selector, not_factors_of_split, off_image_not_unique axiom-free; selector_exists and history_report_criterion Classical.choice only; factor_unique_on_image and extension_unique_of_surjective Quot.sound (funext). Statements match the supports sentences, with two hidden-hypothesis gaps: off_image_not_unique requires an off-image point v0 AND some s distinct from f v0 (so |S| >= 2) and DecidableEq V; the supports prose says only 'a decidable-equality point outside the image can be re-valued'. STRONGEST FINDING (overclaim): narrowest_claim says the direction constancy => factoring 'needs exactly a selector of fiber representatives'. The kernel establishes only SUFFICIENCY of a selector (factors_of_fiberConstant_of_selector) and sufficiency of Classical.choice; no necessity is proved, and necessity is doubtful: the answer is fiber-constant, so the relation 'v is the report of some h whose answer is s' is total and functional, which needs only a unique-choice-type principle, strictly weaker than a representative selector (and for answer valued in Set H, taking fibers, no choice is needed at all). The profile's own does_not_support disclaims independence results, which contradicts the word 'exactly' in narrowest_claim. Also the finite native check is blind to the unpaid obligation: on finite types choice is provable, so all 15 triples (and every semantic mutant) are choice-irrelevant; they only corroborate the combinatorics (factoring count = sum_k C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k), not the choice question. Checker: independent of the producer in that it uses closed forms rather than enumeration, but it does not compute 'fiber_constant' separately from 'factoring': both are set to the same sum, mismatch=0, max_factor_multiplicity (=1 if factoring) and surjective_nonunique=0 are hard-coded theorem assertions; the producer's brute force must match them, which is what gives the check content. Edge: s=0 with h=0, v>0 gives a factoring pair with 0 extensions (s^(v-k)=0), consistent with the formula but the case (0,v>0,0) is absent from the 15 inputs, so 'every factoring pair has s^(v-k) extensions' is never tested where extension count is zero. nonunique_off_image formula fine. Mutants: eight leaf edits with real rationales (every question factors, injective-only, extension unique, surjective with freedom, image vs codomain, criterion fails, two factors, empty histories); none targets the actual unpaid bridge (choice) and none can in a finite model; missing near miss: fiber-constancy for a COARSER or FINER equivalence than the report kernel (answer constant on fibers of a different report) and the S-empty case above. next_test (decide choice-freedom for arbitrary history types, prove or give a choice-free model) is this node's own obligation and distinct from does_not_support, though does_not_support and next_test are close paraphrases of each other; acceptable. DAG: the DAG statement's last clause 'a constructive listed-history version is not established' is stale: node PG-PREGEN-CONSTRUCTIVE-SUMMARY is PROVED_LEAN for listed histories (review.reviewed_target_qualification already says so). Status PROVED_LEAN is fine for the criterion; do not raise.
